lessons.title: Two Loaves at the Door
lessons.goal: 分辨重複配送、原訂數量與負責處理。
lessons.story:
On Tuesdays, Leo usually collects a loaf of bread for his grandmother. Today, a delivery worker leaves two bags outside her door. Each bag holds one loaf and a note with the same order number. Grandmother paid for only one loaf.

Leo wants to open both bags because he is hungry. His grandmother asks him to check the order first. He calls the bakery and reads the number aloud. The baker checks her list and explains that a new worker packed the order twice.

She asks Leo to keep one bag sealed. A worker will collect it before four. Leo puts it on a shelf away from the lunch table. When the worker arrives, Leo hands it back. His grandmother cuts their own loaf, and they share it with some soup.

words.example: Leo collects bread for his grandmother.
Please check the number on the bag.
The sealed bag is still closed.
Put the bag on the shelf.

questions.prompt: How much bread did Grandmother order?
questions.explanation: 祖母只付了一條麵包的錢。
questions.evidence: Grandmother paid for only one loaf.

questions.prompt: What information does Leo give the bakery?
questions.explanation: 他讀出袋上訂單號碼來查核。
questions.evidence: He calls the bakery and reads the number aloud.
reasons: 前文說袋上有相同訂單號碼。

questions.prompt: Why does Leo put one bag away from the lunch table?
options: To hide all the bread from Grandmother.
To keep it unopened for collection.
To let the bread cool in the soup.
questions.explanation: 店家要求保留密封，他把袋子分開以免當午餐拆開。
questions.evidence: She asks Leo to keep one bag sealed. A worker will collect it before four.
reasons: 與保留密封、等候收回一致。
沒有將麵包放入湯中降溫。

questions.explanation: 袋子要等工作人員取回，sealed 指維持未拆封。
questions.evidence: She asks Leo to keep one bag sealed.
reasons: 與暫時不拆袋的情境一致。
吃完不能交回完整袋子。

questions.prompt: What best shows that the second loaf was a packing mistake?
options: The bakery confirms that one order was packed twice.
questions.explanation: 相同訂單號碼提供線索；店家核對後確認重複包裝，證據最直接。
questions.evidence: The baker checks her list and explains that a new worker packed the order twice.
reasons: 固定收麵包不能證明多包。
取回時間本身不說明成因。
店家核對紀錄後明確確認。

questions.prompt: What is the main lesson of Leo’s experience?
options: Finish lunch before calling a shop.
Never accept bread from a new worker.
Always order extra food for visitors.
Check an unexpected delivery before using it.
questions.explanation: 全文重點是先確認多收到的東西，再依店家說明處理。
questions.evidence: His grandmother asks him to check the order first.
reasons: 不能因一次失誤否定所有新員工。
